action: United customers who use AI assistants or automated tools to book or manage travel: expect these to be blocked and use the airline's own website or app. Businesses offering agent-based booking should review the airline's terms.
exec: A large airline is restricting automated AI access to customer services on security grounds, a possible precedent for other consumer firms.
plain: United Airlines plans to stop customers from using AI assistants that act on their behalf on its services, saying this is because of cyber threats.
summary: The Record reported the airline's decision four days before its systems outage. No connection between the two has been reported.
title: United Airlines to block customers from using AI agents, citing cyber threats
